key_actions.summary: Begins composing Kitāb al-Shifāʾ (The Book of Healing), a multi-volume philosophical encyclopedia.
Completes Al-Qānūn fī al-Ṭibb (The Canon of Medicine), the standard medical textbook of the Islamic world and (via Latin translation) of medieval European universities until the 17th century.
Dies at Hamadan; leaves a Peripatetic philosophical tradition (mashshāʾī) that decisively shapes both Sunni theology and Latin scholasticism via Albertus Magnus and Aquinas.

name_variants: Abū ʿAlī al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAbd Allāh Ibn Sīnā
